I have a number of friends who say they are libertarians. I think many young people throw the term around because they don't want to be associated with the bigotry that some feel is pervasive in the republican party. Basically I would say they are young republicans who don't hate gay people.

I think to some degree you're correct, but I've seen a lot of people that identify as 'left-libertarians', which I assume is implying that they're fine with a lot of things like social services, but sick of the increasingly pervasive government presence in their lives.
Left libertarians want to have their cake and eat it too. "I only want the government to interfere in people's lives in the ways that I think are okay".
Isn't the same true of right libertarians? I mean, if you advocate having any government at all, it's going to be going down that route.
I suspect that if the US voting system used transferrable votes the political landscape would look very different indeed.
